summary: Conan strategy brief (docs/bots/CONAN_STRATEGY_BRIEF.md) for the next stage of #1206: a calibrated Read of the position (effect descriptors, two-sided ledger, belief about the opponent's hand, battle exchange, posture) with contextual rules on top, replacing the search-first direction. Supporting research under docs/bots/strategy/: Mendon's decision model from eight replays, nine rule families with seed rules, an arena behaviour profile over 4,000+ logged games (good and weak bot behaviour), rules digest, code map; analysis scripts in tools/bots/behaviour/. Block 8400 baseline recorded. Docs and scripts only; no bot behaviour or default changed.
validation: Block 8400 (364 games each, frozen Contender T2): Contender A/A 192-172 (52.7%), Conan-best 271-93 (74.5%), net +79 on the same games; matches blocks 7800-8100. Behaviour scripts rerun from the repo copy on logs-r78/r79/r81 (1,091 games) reproduce the committed tables; every figure cited in ARENA_BEHAVIOUR.md and RULE_FAMILIES.md checked against the final tables. No C# changed, so no test run.
remaining: The work the brief describes (steps 0-6) is not started. Mendon to answer a screenshot interview on Cavalry forcing and on the counter-attack at two Provinces or fewer (PLAYER_MODEL.md section 5); arena tables are observational and Mendon's sample is seven games.
